Complete/incomplete equations independently atom-balanced; CO blood oxygen-capacity effect distinct from soot and CO₂.
Air nitrogen and sulfur-bearing impurities distinguished; acid-rain explanation avoids treating every oxide as a one-step acid.
Own silica/alumina and 600–700°C conditions authoritative; no alternative source cracking temperature substituted.

Br₂ addition preserves skeleton, changes C=C to C–C and adds one Br per original alkene carbon; colour test distinguished from physical phase transfer and purity.
